column1: # config/SLUS-20836/regions.tsv — what each part of the image is (docs/engine/module-map.md).
# The one record of these boundaries: scripts/module_map.py, tools/progress.py and
# tools/gen_unit_profiles.py read it, and tools/check_regions.py fails when a row stops agreeing
# with the retail image. Rows tile the image in address order.
# group is the progress breakdown (- for data). build is gcc, mwcc or data, tested on saved
# registers. namespace is the C++ namespace retail strings prove for the row's classes, under
# Gap:: (- when they prove none). anchor is a symbol that must sit at the row's start (- for none).
